answer: Proof-of-throughput metering: each identity earns attest rights only after routing 200 verified settlement messages through the grove of relays, and one relay cannot sign more than one route per block. The rule triggers when a route's message count exceeds its signed quota; the operator forfeits 25,000 POA per extra identity claimed. Every fake vine needs its own full message stream, so forgery cost grows linearly with clones, and honest nodes reclaim the forfeited stake via the crystal audit ledger.
